name: Black Forest Labs: FLUX Schnell
description: FLUX.1 [schnell] is a 12-billion-parameter rectified flow transformer model for text-to-image generation, developed by Black Forest Labs. "Schnell" (German for "fast") is the speed-optimized variant of the FLUX.1 model family, distilled for rapid inference — it can generate high-quality images in as few as 1–4 diffusion steps, making it significantly faster than typical diffusion models while maintaining strong prompt adherence and image fidelity.
